set.approach: Starting at Applebee camp, drop eastward over broken ground to the large boulder, a very short distance off. The wide crack splits its south wall, and Shitter Crack is the short finger-pod crack just left of the outhouses.
The boulder sits right behind the Kain hut. The route is on the left side of the boulder's west face.

review.notes: Route page: location. Area page: behind the Kain hut; fixed rope ladder to bolted anchors on top. Lead review dropped the descent: it described reaching the top anchor, not getting down.

set.approach: Approach is the same as for Crown Mountain, reached by hiking either from Grouse via the Grouse Grind and Crown Pass, or up the Hanes Valley trail from Lynn Headwaters Regional Park. Shortly before Crown's summit, veer left and contour round the peak's north flank, then go down a fixed line to the foot of the Camel. The route is on the southeast face, up the head of the Camel.

review.notes: Camel area page for the traverse and fixed line; Crown Mountain and Camel parent page for the hiking access. Route page for the anchor access. Lead review dropped the descent: it described reaching the top anchor, not getting down.
